dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) program; compiler options in comments reference 'cobc -x' with -fbinary-size, -fnotrunc, -fbinary-byteorder flags typical of GnuCOBOL. LGPL license by Sauro Menna, 2016.
evidence: GNU Lesser General Public License, LGPL, 3.0

purpose.domain_detail: COBOL sort utility that reads an input file, sorts records by a character key field, accumulates/sums numeric fields per key group, and writes summarized output records.
purpose.summary: This program sorts an input sequential file by srt-ch-field (ascending), groups records by that key, and sums all numeric fields (binary, float, packed-decimal, zoned-decimal, etc.) within each group. It writes one summarized output record per key group. It is part of a suite of COBOL sort/sum demonstration modules by Sauro Menna.

notable_features: SORT verb with INPUT PROCEDURE and OUTPUT PROCEDURE
COMP-1 (single-precision float) and COMP-2 (double-precision float) fields
SIGN IS LEADING / TRAILING SEPARATE clauses
REDEFINES clause on sort record fields
COPY wktotsum01 for totalizer working storage
Environment variable checking via ACCEPT FROM ENVIRONMENT
GOBACK with RETURN-CODE for error handling
verdict.notes: The file contains commented-out debug lines prefixed with 'test00**' which are treated as comments in fixed-format COBOL (columns 1-6 area). The program references a COPY member 'wktotsum01' for totalizer fields. Part of a larger suite of sort/sum demonstration programs by Sauro Menna released under LGPL 3.0.
